title: Strix: Re-Thinking NPU Reliability from a System Perspective
extraction_scope: Selected HTML experimental prose, Section 5; PDF page 6 Table 1 visually transcribed; Table 2 and Figure 9 visually inspected without numerical extraction

pdf_verification.method: Local PyMuPDF 2x rendering and same-agent visual inspection

latency_table.scope: Detection only; no table evidence for BF16-I or correction/localisation timing.

artifact_discovery.limit: Bounded discovery attempt, not proof of unavailability; do not substitute upstream Gemmini for Strix implementation.

interpretation_limits: Synthesis estimates are not fabricated-silicon measurements.
Do not combine FPGA and simulated configurations into universal hardware validation.
Fault-injection coverage does not establish safety certification or coverage of every fault model.
Other figure-level denominators, Strix implementation revisions and variance remain unchecked.
